title: Agartala case is filed
detail: The state initiated a high-profile conspiracy case against Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and others.

title: Public anger and solidarity expand
detail: The prosecution deepened anti-regime sentiment and energized student and civic mobilization across East Pakistan.

title: Case collapses under mass pressure
detail: Sustained mass movement pressure contributed to the withdrawal of the case and release of detainees, feeding directly into the uprising moment.
